$comment: The app-wide themes: what an application's theme can be. Read by the backend (catalog/AppThemes.java, which checks a theme before it's saved) and the editor and exported app (core/rendering/app-theme.ts, which turns a theme into the CSS variables every widget reads). A theme is a preset, or 'Custom' with its own primary color, font, corners and spacing. Fonts are system font stacks, so an exported app needs nothing from the internet.

fonts.Segoe UI: 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif
fonts.System: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
fonts.Rounded: ui-rounded, 'SF Pro Rounded', 'Nunito', 'Varela Round', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif
fonts.Serif: 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
fonts.Mono: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Code', 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
